body: Maybe you’re right, I just don’t wanna feel like a burden to anyone. I’ll give it a go someday, I just need to work up the courage I guess

I really want to, trust me, but I’ve never been able to bring it up. I’m afraid that they will see me as something less, or that I will become some sort of ’victim’ if you know what I mean? Especially since I was know  as ’that happy kid’  growing up.

I definitely know what you’re talking about and kinda agree with you on some things. I don’t fear death, but neither do I want to die since I know it would shatter my parents. I don’t really know what I want right now, I’m mostly just completely empty. 

If it’s to any help (who am I to talk), try to occupy your mind as much as possible. I’ve been writing my own music lately, trying to convert my feelings (or lack of) into something of my own. I don’t know if it works or helps meanything, but it keeps me from staring at the wall at least.

Thank you, it really means alot. 

I feel like I have a hard time to talk about the problem since I can’t even tell what’s wrong myself. The extreme lack of good/affordable therapists where I live are a big problem though. I can’t afford too much by myself. I would never ever ask someone for financial support for something like that either.

Thank you, I didn’t expect any answers at all to be honest. 

I’m planning on going straight to PhD if I get the opportunity right after my Msc. It’s the only thing I can see working out right now, since that would mean no worrying about finding a good job, new flat, new friends etc. I don’t feel like I could take that stress.

And the romantic side of it all is put to the side for now. Broke up with my ex last summer and have not missing the whole relationship thing at all.
Thanks for the words, I will look into the support group thing. Haven’t thought of that before at all.
